items.question: How do I remove text from image online?
items.answer: Upload a supported image, continue with Google, start processing, review the result, and download it if it meets your needs.

items.question: Is WatermarkGemini free to use?
items.answer: Yes. WatermarkGemini is free to use. Google sign-in is required to start processing.

items.question: What image formats are supported?
items.answer: You can upload one JPG, PNG, or WEBP image up to 10 MB.

items.question: Do I need to sign in?
items.answer: Yes. You can choose a file while signed out, but Google sign-in is required before processing starts.

items.question: How long are uploaded files kept?
items.answer: Uploads, results, and processing records are designed to expire after 24 hours. Temporary signed links expire sooner.

items.question: Can I process images in bulk?
items.answer: No. The current uploader accepts one image at a time.

items.question: Will every background look perfect after text is removed?
items.answer: Results can vary with the text and background. Always compare the processed image with the original before downloading.

items.question: Can I remove copyrighted text or watermarks?
items.answer: Only edit images you own or have permission to modify. Do not remove marks to evade licensing or misrepresent authorship.
